messages:
elaine: Quick check-in on the Console observability roadmap: customers keep asking for a simple "sampling presets + cost preview" flow. We need clear launch criteria and a short rollout plan.

sam: +1. Proposal: three presets (low-cost, balanced, full-fidelity) + a custom slider for per-route sampling. Each preset maps to rollup window + sampling rates.

anya: UX constraints: the cost preview must show both estimated monthly token/storage delta and a small trace thumbnail illustrating what visibility is lost/gained. Include an inline "why this affects cost" tooltip.

rachel: Ops perspective: presets must be safe by default. "low-cost" should never drop error traces; it can downsample non-error tails. We should also provide an "emergency capture" button that temporarily forces 100% sampling for a route.

sam: Implementation sketch: preset -> {"rollup": "60s"/"5s"/"raw", "sample_default": 0.02/0.1/1.0, "sample_errors": 1.0}. We'll wire cost estimation using current QPS + average span tokens; back-of-envelope accuracy target +/-20% for MVP.

elaine: Launch acceptance criteria draft: (1) UI can apply a preset to a tenant and persist policy. (2) Cost preview computed within 20% for synthetic workload. (3) Trace thumbnails rendered for sampled traces with rollup applied. (4) Emergency capture toggles and rollback within UI. (5) Feature gated + telemetry events for policy changes.

anya: For the thumbnails, we can show two tiny timelines side-by-side: before policy and after policy (sampled). Keep images small and fast to render. Also add an export button to download the JSON policy and sample IDs used for the thumbnail.

rachel: SLOs we'd like: emergency capture success >99%, policy apply propagation <60s to ingestion pipeline, cost-estimate job <500ms for single-tenant preview.

sam: Engineering constraints: collector will need a lightweight policy cache and a per-route evaluation hook. Rollup tuning: 5s rollup increases collector memory by ~8% at 95th percentile. Need perf spec.

elaine: Prioritization — MVP (ship in beta): presets + cost preview + emergency capture + export. Post-MVP: auto-suggestions (Optimize), per-tenant historical recommend, and SDK hooks for programmatic policy application.

anya: Acceptance test plan: create deterministic replay traffic (mix of success, tail latency, and error cases), apply each preset, assert sampled proportion per class matches expected +/-5%, assert cost estimate vs billing simulator within target.

rachel: Rollout plan: feature-flag initial rollout to internal customers -> opt-in beta for 5 tenants -> broaden to general availability after 2 weeks and no missed regressions. Include rollout rollback playbook.

devops-bot: Staging job scheduled: observability-presets/v1 -> staging 2098769000. Feature-flag: obs.presets.beta.

elaine: Action items: Sam -> perf spec + collector policy cache prototype by Fri. Anya -> thumbnails + cost widget mocks by Wed. Rachel -> rollout + runbook + SLO doc by Mon. I'll update the roadmap ticket and attach acceptance criteria. Please add short comments if you disagree. :rocket:
